title: Tree tracking area units and zero-valued measurements
status: source repair and synthetic disposable checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Tree-density reads use the deployed plot.area and plot.area_unit columns instead of nonexistent plot.area_ha, including the matching GROUP BY.
Known hectare, square-meter, and acre units are normalized to hectares; non-positive, missing, and unsupported areas produce unavailable density rather than a misleading value.
Growth deltas treat zero as a measurement instead of missing data, and canopy averages include canopy-only trees and zero growth.
Forward migration 462 updates the public density view with the same unit conversions and unknown/zero-area behavior without editing applied migration 057.

verification.migration_tests: tests/test_migration.py passed in the combined 53-test run

scope_limits: The disposable PostGIS instance used minimal synthetic tables and was removed; candidate and legacy databases were untouched.
Migration 462 has not been rolled out to the local candidate.
Silvi/provider behavior, populated legacy parity, pest analytics, and spatial export parity remain unassessed; CAP-054 remains unaccepted pending MAN-CAP-054 review.
